narrative.overview:
Commodity Chain is an Operate surface: a regulated institutional console, not a marketing site and not a farm marketplace. The visual world is the category standard — left rail, work surface, tables, one primary action — executed at the craft of a KASE operator console and an Addepar portfolio desk. Convention is the commitment. There is no rustic grain, no carbon-copy novelty, no crypto neon, and no irony.

The old frontend (warm cream, olive, IBM Plex, Source Serif, stacked shadcn cards) is anti-reference. This seed describes the target world. The shell has NOT yet been restyled: src/app/globals.css still carries the previous Harvest Capital tokens and typography. See DESIGN.md section 10 for the honest transition boundary.

Golos Text is the single face because the quality bar is a Kazakhstan exchange plus an international fund desk, and the product must set Kazakh, Russian, and English without a display/body theatre pairing.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy rail, light work surface, solid exchange blue for actions only
Tables, workflow status, documents, and transactions outrank cards
Tight radius, hairline rules, almost no shadow
Dual literacy: plain stage names for farmers; institutional density for funds and regulators

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exchange Navy appears on the current action, the current nav item, and focus. It does not paint backgrounds, icons tiles, or chart decoration.

rules.name: The No-Theatre Status Rule
rules.body: Status is a word (and optional small chip). Do not encode the product as a rainbow of metric cards.

rules.name: The Farmer-Plain Type Rule
rules.body: Stage names are Field, Contract, Pool, Coverage, Token, Placement — not instruction codes. Domain enums (VERIFIED, IN_POOL) stay as enums; surrounding copy stays human.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow is a state of overlapping UI, not a personality for panels.

rules.name: The Protocol-Context Rule
rules.body: The Exchange Desk is the global Commodity Chain shell. Harvest Capital is a Field to Finance contextual layer only and must never define the global shell or any non-agriculture protocol (Water, Music Rights, Gaming Assets).

dos: Do put the job in a table or a document with one primary action.
Do keep the prototype badge visible on every shell.
Do use Golos Text at the sizes above; use tabular figures for tonnes and money.
Do match KASE/Addepar craft: calm density, official tone, no decoration.
donts: Don't use cream grounds, olive accents, IBM Plex, or Source Serif (discarded frontend).
Don't use purple or blue gradients, glassmorphism, oversized radius, or decorative icon tiles.
Don't nest cards or fill Overview with statistics.
Don't invent AFSA permission, commercial prices, legal names, or on-chain figures beyond recorded proof.
Don't treat Field-to-Finance as the platform name, or WHEAT-2027 as the platform.
Don't apply agriculture imagery or Harvest Capital styling to the global shell or to a non-agriculture protocol.
